meetingMinutes.title: Meeting Minutes
meetingMinutes.description: Record meeting agenda, attendees, discussions, and action items systematically
meetingMinutes.speaker: Speaker
meetingMinutes.decisionsPlaceholder: Record decisions reached during the meeting

sections.title: Quick Start
items: Use a template button to auto-populate agenda items for your meeting type
Fill in basic info (title, date, location, organizer) first
Add attendees and mark their attendance status
Set time allocations per agenda item to manage the meeting schedule
Send a transcript from Voice Memo and choose excerpts for discussions, decisions and action items.

sections.title: Managing Action Items
items: Add action items immediately as decisions are made during the meeting
Assign a clear owner and due date to each task
Update statuses (Pending / In Progress / Done) regularly
Review action item completion before the next meeting

sections.title: Export & Share
items: Copy Text: paste into email or messaging apps
Export MD: use in GitHub, Notion, Confluence, etc.
Export HTML: open in browser or paste as email body
Print: switch to Preview tab first for clean print output

sections.title: Save & Auto-Save
items: Your content is auto-saved to the browser (survives tab close)
Use named save slots to keep multiple meeting minutes
Type a slot name and press Enter or click Save
Use Load to restore any previously saved minutes

whatIs.title: What is the Meeting Minutes Maker?
whatIs.description: A digital meeting minutes tool for systematically recording meeting date/time, attendees, agenda items, discussion points, decisions, and action items, then exporting as PDF or text. The structured template supports quick note-taking during meetings or polishing notes afterward. Saves in a format easy to share via email or messenger.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: 1. Enter basic meeting info (date/time, location, title, facilitator).
2. Add attendee list (name, department, role).
3. Record discussion points and decisions for each agenda item.
4. Add action items (assignee, deadline, task) and save as PDF or text.

tips.title: Pro Tips
items: Pre-entering agenda items before the meeting helps keep discussion on track.
Write action items clearly in 'who does what by when' format for easier follow-through.
Complete and distribute meeting minutes within 30 minutes of the meeting ending for best results.

items.q: Can I email meeting minutes directly from here?
items.a: Direct email sending isn't available. Save as PDF or text, then attach or paste the content into your email.

items.q: Can I load previous minutes to continue?
items.a: Your current notes are saved automatically in this browser. You can also keep and restore named copies in saved slots.

items.q: Can I export in Markdown format?
items.a: Yes, Markdown export is available. Paste directly into GitHub, Notion, Confluence, or any Markdown-supporting collaboration tool.

import.title: Turn a voice memo into meeting notes
import.hint: Choose sentences and place them in discussions, decisions or action items. Correct recognition errors before adding them. No summaries, owners or deadlines are inferred.
import.privacy: Your audio stays in the original tab. The transferred text stays in this tab and is not included in the URL.
import.noSentences: No sentences to select. Check the transcript in the voice memo.
import.appendHint: Only selected text is appended to the current notes. Existing content is kept. An empty title uses the memo name. Add up to 100 excerpts and 12,000 characters at a time.
import.applied: Selected text was added and saved in this browser. Review the owners and deadlines for action items.
import.alreadyImported: This memo was already added to these meeting notes. It was not added again.
import.unavailable: The transferred text is missing or its 10-minute window has expired. Send it again from the voice memo tab.
import.invalidSelection: Could not add the selection. Check the number and length of excerpts, or export your notes before trying again.

storage.unreadable: Existing saved data could not be read. Overwriting is disabled. Check browser storage settings. You can still export the current notes.
storage.conflict: Another tab changed the saved data. Overwriting was stopped. Export your changes before reloading this tab.
storage.failed: Could not save to this device. Your input remains on screen. Check storage space or browser settings, or export it to a file.
storage.copyFailed: Could not copy. Please export a file instead.
storage.saved: Saved in this browser. Clearing site data deletes these notes.
storage.unsaved: There are changes that have not been saved yet.

kanban.title: Send action items to Kanban
kanban.description: Choose the actions agreed in your meeting and continue tracking them on a Kanban board.
kanban.copyHint: Send copies with their assignees, due dates, and statuses. Your original minutes stay intact; later edits do not sync between the two tools.
kanban.empty: There are no action items yet. Add tasks to your meeting minutes before sending them.
kanban.taskTooLong: Each task can contain up to 6,000 characters.
kanban.assigneeTooLong: Shorten the assignee to 120 characters or fewer.
kanban.invalidDate: Use a real due date in YYYY-MM-DD format, or leave it empty.
kanban.invalidStatus: Set the status to pending, in progress, or done.
kanban.invalidIdentity: This item's identifier is invalid. Re-create it as a new action item.
kanban.invalidItems: {count} items need changes. Their reasons are shown below; you can select them after fixing them.
kanban.titleTooLong: The meeting title exceeds 120 characters. Shorten it in the meeting details before sending.
kanban.totalTooLong: Selected task descriptions exceed 30,000 characters in total. Deselect some items.
kanban.limitReached: You have selected 50 items. Deselect an item before choosing another.
kanban.noSelection: Select the action items to send to Kanban.
kanban.sendHint: Review the destination columns in a new tab before adding the items. New cards have medium priority. Previously imported actions are neither duplicated nor overwritten.
kanban.opened: Kanban opened in a new tab. Review the destination columns and add the items there.
kanban.storageFailed: The minutes could not be saved on this device, so nothing was sent. Check the save notice above and try again.
kanban.popupBlocked: The new tab could not open. Allow pop-ups for this site, then try again.
kanban.handoffFailed: The actions could not be transferred to the new tab. Check your browser storage settings and try again.
kanban.invalidSelection: These items cannot be sent. Check their descriptions, assignees, dates, statuses, and selection limits.
kanban.blocked: Save the minutes before sending. Check the save notice above.
kanban.loading: Loading the minutes saved on this device.
